newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania Q3 trade deficit swells to 19.5 bln leks.
newsitem.headline: Albania Q3 trade deficit swells to 19.5 bln leks.

text.p: Albania's Institute of Statistics reported the following economic indicators on Wednesday:
ALBANIAN FOREIGN TRADE 1996 Q3 1996 Q2 1995 Q3
Note: The Institute said the government and the International Monetary Fund expected the trade deficit to widen to 26 billion leks by the end of the year.
The private sector accounted for 79.8 percent of exports and 84 percent of imports.

Textiles and shoes represented 47.2 percent of total exports. Food, beverages and tobacco accounted for 37.9 percent of imports. Machinery, equipment and spare parts accounted for 19.4 percent of imports.
Italy remained Albania's main trading partner, taking 51.36 percent of exports and supplying 37.5 percent of imports.
The Institute said 87.5 percent of exports were to European Union member countries. The EU was the source of 73.1 percent of imports.
